notes:
A350 and 777:
• Fixed: When the Cabin app isn't running, the seat screens now say so instead of asking you to turn on an option that is already on.
• New: The Movies page shows where your own films go (Documents\Seatback IFE\Films).
• Improved: Every airline goes onto both aircraft, and new or updated airline designs from our server arrive by themselves.
App:
• Improved: Each install checks that Flight Simulator will start the Cabin app (YouTube and films), fixes its entry in exe.xml, and test-starts it.
• New: If Flight Simulator didn't start the Cabin app, the installer starts it. Settings shows whether it is running, with a Start now button.
• Improved: Wi-Fi & films is on by default.
• Improved: No more Airlines page, and Settings keep only what you set yourself. The rest keeps your earlier choices.
